High quality tellurium copper single and double chrome nozzles with perfect concentricity. Our fiber laser cutting consistency improved immediately, and express delivery arrived in 24 hours.
Ordered OSPRI LC80 protective windows and SMC ITV proportional valve. Genuine parts that resolved our gas pressure fluctuations immediately. Highly recommended!

We run two 6kW RayTools BM111 heads on double shifts. Previously, our protective glass would crack within 40 cutting hours. The D27.9 fused silica windows from NK Laser easily cross 150 hours on 12mm MS piercing without focal drift. Exceptional optical coating!

Ordered 100 pcs of 1.5mm and 2.0mm double chrome tellurium nozzles. The concentricity is laser-calibrated with zero beam grazing on high-pressure nitrogen cutting of 4mm SS304. Very smooth burr-free edge.

Original KT B2 CON ceramic body and rings for our Precitec cutting head. Solid brass threads that do not cross-thread during quick nozzle changes. Capacitance tracking remains razor sharp on corrugated sheets.

Replaced an erratic ITV2050 valve that was causing rough slag on 16mm plates. NK Laser sent genuine SMC Japan unit with proper factory testing certificate. Assist gas pressure regulation is now butter-smooth.

Replaced burnt collimation lens inside our 4kW Raytools head. NK Laser provided matched focal doublet with AR coating for 1064nm. Spot size is tight and cutting speed on 3mm aluminium improved by 18%.
Had intermittent head collision errors due to worn RF coaxial cable. Received gold-plated BMA to SMA cable and backup BCS100 sensor board. Calibration worked on first try without hunting.

Essential maintenance pack for our S&A CWFL-6000 dual circuit chiller. Deionizer resin brought water conductivity down from 28 uS/cm to under 1.2 uS/cm within an hour. Saves the QBH fiber connector from overheating.
Regular supplier for our WSX NC30 heads. Ceramic bodies, D30*5mm protective glasses, and single nozzles are always in stock. Best wholesale rates in Western India.
Quality of tellurium copper nozzle is superior to generic local copies. We cut 2000 chassis gussets daily in 6mm structural steel without tip deformation or spatter adhesion.
Certified EN207 compliant laser safety glasses for our operator team. Excellent optical clarity with zero color distortion while maintaining certified optical density at 1064nm fiber wavelength.
Ordered D32 double chrome nozzles 2.5mm and 3.0mm. Nitrogen flow is clean with zero vortex turbulence, resulting in mirror-finish cutting on 5mm SS316 food-grade tanks.
Purchased authentic CypNest nesting license key from NK Laser. Auto common-line cutting and fly-cutting saved us nearly 11% raw sheet metal scrap every month.
Pack of 20 protective lenses arrived securely packed in cleanroom blister cases. Fused quartz quality is top tier, no inclusions or microscopic surface scratches.
Using these ceramic rings on our 3kW Bodor head. Thermal insulation between nozzle and capacitive sensor ring is top tier, no sensor false trigger even during continuous oxygen piercing.
Hard-to-find sealing rings and upper collimator protective windows for OSPRI LC208 were supplied off-the-shelf. Very knowledgeable technical support on WhatsApp.
High damage threshold focus lens with 125mm focal length. Focal spot remains uniform across the entire 1500x3000mm bed area. Clean piercing without back-reflection damage.
1.2mm and 1.4mm single nozzles for precision 1.5mm to 3.0mm MS electrical cabinet cutting. Very clean hole piercing with minimal taper. Reordering next batch soon.
Lint-free cleanroom optical wipes, high-purity cleaning solution, and protective dust caps for QBH fiber cable. Cleaned our output quartz block without leaving any residue.
Tellurium copper alloy has much higher thermal conductivity than brass copies. Spatters don’t stick and clean easily with brass wire brush. Highly durable.
Upgraded our 4kW to 6kW laser machine. NK Laser supplied the correct D37*7mm upper and D27.9 lower protective glasses with high wattage AR coatings. Running stable 24x7.
Quick dispatch of CypCut I/O terminal board and DB37 connection cable. Solved our pneumatic shuttle table interlock issue on the same day.
Conical shaped 3.5mm nozzle designed for thick plate piercing (20mm and 22mm MS). Piercing time dropped from 3.2 seconds to 1.8 seconds with minimal spatter eruption.
Ceramic rings with gold plated contact pads. Excellent resistance to thermal cracking even when cutting red-hot ceramic furnace brackets in 10mm SS310.
Got bulk discount for 50 pieces protective glasses. Every piece tested for 0.15% reflection loss. We run three machines and our monthly optics budget was reduced by 30%.
Accurate fitment for our German Precitec LightCutter head. Nozzle holder and sealing O-rings fitted snugly with zero gas leakage around the thread.
Dual-line gas manifold regulation spares. Clean wiring diagram and fast delivery. Helps maintain steady 18 bar pressure during nitrogen cutting.
Comprehensive nozzle starter kit with all calibers. Chrome plating is uniform, zero flaking even after prolonged high-temperature exposure.
The v6 remote has much better wireless range across our 40-meter shop floor. Operators can jog axes and test dry run without running back to the CNC console.
High-temperature fused silica substrate from Corning / Heraeus grade quartz. No black spots or micro-pitting after heavy 16mm plate cutting.
Genuine RayTools ceramic ring with robust M11 thread. No wobbling of nozzle tip, capacitive height tracking maintains exactly 0.8mm gap smoothly.
Consistent cutting taper on 8mm carbon steel with oxygen assist. Nozzle diameter tolerance is within 0.01mm. Excellent craftsmanship.
Replaced saturated deionizer cartridge in our Hanli 12kW chiller. Prevented high conductivity alarms on our IPG laser source. Prompt delivery by DTDC.
Direct drop-in replacement for WSX head. High laser transmission efficiency with virtually no thermal lensing effect even at 100% duty cycle.
Flexible high-frequency RF cable with spring strain relief. Doesn’t snap during rapid Z-axis acceleration and frog-jump piercing routines.
Perfect for 2.5mm and 3.0mm CRCA sheet cutting in our die-making facility. Clean sharp corners without burning or rounding off.
The optical clarity is stunning. Our focal position calibration remained steady across continuous 16-hour shifts on agricultural implements.
Supplied reinforced 12mm high pressure polyurethane tubing rated for 25 bar working pressure. Resolved our frequent gas pipe bursting issues during N2 cutting.
